name: store-manager-app
description: Full-stack shop management app for local businesses

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix store/server && npm install --prefix store/client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:store: concurrently -n store-server,store-client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix store/server" "npm run dev --prefix store/client"
